title: Give AI a better brief
description: State the goal Add the context and output format. Check the result.

title: Ground AI answers
description: Provide a source Ask for a quote with each claim. Check the quote yourself.

title: What CI checks
description: Push a change Run the build and tests automatically. Fix failures before merging.

title: Plan a rollback
description: Know the last good release Keep its artifact available. Verify health after rollback.

title: Health vs. readiness
description: Is it running? Can it take traffic now? Check both separately.

title: Make a task startable
description: Pick one task Write the next physical action. Make the first step small.

title: A clearer handoff
description: Say what changed Name the owner and open issue. Agree on the next check-in.

title: Build visual hierarchy
description: Pick the main action Give it the clearest contrast. Give secondary actions room.

title: Design useful errors
description: Say what happened Point to the affected field. Tell people how to recover.

title: Think in functions
description: Pick one responsibility Give the function clear inputs. Return a useful result.

title: Reproduce a bug
description: Make the bug repeatable Reduce it to a small example. Change one thing at a time.

title: Percent change
description: Start with the old value Divide the change by the old value. Multiply the result by 100.

title: Mean and median
description: Add, then divide The median is the middle sorted value. Use it to reduce outlier effects.

title: Read a map scale
description: Find the scale bar Compare the map distance to the bar. Check the units.

title: Why time zones exist
description: Earth rotates Different places face the Sun at different times. Time zones standardize local clocks.

title: What a control does
description: Keep a comparison Change one condition in the test group. Compare both outcomes.

title: Read a primary source
description: Start with the author Ask when and why it was made. Compare it with another source.

title: Remember a new word
description: Recall before checking Use the word in a sentence. Review it again later.
